# Acme Field Notes

> Short, practical essays on craft, tooling, and shipping software — written to be read by humans and quoted accurately by machines.

This site is static, server-rendered, and semantic. Every page has a clean Markdown
variant at `<path>.md`. Content is licensed for citation with attribution.

## Essays
- [Why SSR matters for AI agents](https://example.com/essays/ssr-for-agents.md): crawlers read raw HTML, not hydrated DOM
- [Designing past the default template](https://example.com/essays/anti-slop-design.md): committing to one bold aesthetic

## Reference
- [About](https://example.com/about.md): who writes this and why
- [Tools](https://example.com/tools.md): the stack behind the site
